visualCharacteristics: Orange "questions?" band with a heading and a white box (or, in the cards variant, separate white cards) listing contact channels with icon, name, text and link.
contentPattern:
Head row with only headings:

title and optional

sub line; then one row per channel: icon image,

channel name,

text and

link (link label may start with a :glyph: icon).
usage: Use near the bottom of a page to offer contact channels such as phone, chat and shop.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any contact-options band; add the cards class for separate channel cards instead of one combined box.
